data: This course delves into advanced concepts and techniques in analytical chemistry, focusing on both theoretical principles and practical applications. Topics include modern instrumental methods such as advanced spectroscopy (e.g., NMR, mass spectrometry, and X-ray techniques), chromatography, electrochemical analysis, and hyphenated techniques (e.g., GC-MS, LC-MS). Emphasis will be placed on data analysis, signal processing, and error minimization to ensure accurate and reproducible results. Students will explore applications of analytical chemistry in fields such as environmental monitoring, pharmaceutical analysis, forensic science, and material characterization. Hands-on laboratory sessions, case studies, and discussions on cutting-edge research will equip students with the skills needed to tackle complex analytical problems in both academic and industrial settings.
